  • Key Focus Area: Structural frame sign-off, early facade glazing completion, and exterior terrace pergola assembly.

Corrective actions have been issued via Odoo Site Remarks without impacting the critical path.

  • Phase 2: Building Envelope & Glazing (Cafeteria Zone) — 65% Completed

  • Phase 3: Outdoor Terraces & Pergola Structures — 40% Completed

  • Phase 4: MEP Rough-Ins & Interior Finishes — 0% Completed (Scheduled for Next Month)

3. Quality Control & Site Remarks Log

2 defect items were logged during the pre-delivery walkthrough of the Cafeteria sector and are accounted for in the current phase tracking.

4. Financials & Change Management Overview

  • Budget Status: On Budget.

  • Contract Variations / Change Orders:

    • Both logged defect repairs are classified under Subcontractor Liability / Warranty; zero impact on the project contingency fund or main contract value.
